topic: The Trent Affair: Civil War Diplomatic Crisis
pillar: Events that changed the modern world
hook: During the American Civil War, a Union warship stopped a British mail packet and almost dragged the British Empire into the war.

evidence.title: 1861: American Civil War: The "Trent Affair": The USS San Jacinto stops the British mail ship Trent and arrests two Confederate envoys, sparking a diplomatic crisis between the UK and US.

angle: Focus on how a rogue American naval captain's unauthorized seizure of Confederate diplomats nearly forced Lincoln into fighting a two-front war against both the Confederacy and the British Empire.
what_others_do: Existing videos typically treat the Trent Affair as a dry, straightforward chronology of international law and maritime disputes.
